answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in a single breath. Time keeps the violet, the ledger keeps the anchor, the workshop keeps the wharf; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. Stake 5 times the reward and the farm must park 150742 POA to chase 667 seats it may never win. Name the threshold Clockmaker hourglass warrant struck within the gear room: it admits each hourglass is a timing record the assay inspector witnessed and nothing else, and it remembers every face it has seen. The farm brought counterfeits to a market that trades only in proof, and the market sent it home.
